description_en: Queries the line types of elastic IP addresses (EIPs) that are supported in an acceleration region
description_zh: 调用ListIspTypes接口查询加速地域支持的公网线路类型
name: ListIspTypes

parameters.help_en: The ID of the acceleration region to be queried
parameters.name: business_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the Global Accelerator (GA) instance to be queried. Valid values:

basic: basic GA instance
standard: standard GA instance
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的全球加速实例类型。取值：
basic：基础型全球加速实例。
standard：标准型全球加速实例
parameters.name: accelerator_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the GA instance that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的全球加速实例ID
parameters.name: accelerator_id

IspTypeList.description_en:
The line types of EIPs in the acceleration region.

BGP (default): BGP (Multi-ISP) lines
BGP_PRO: BGP (Multi-ISP) Pro lines

If you have the permissions to use single-ISP bandwidth, one of the following values may be returned:

ChinaTelecom: China Telecom (single ISP)
ChinaUnicom: China Unicom (single ISP)
ChinaMobile: China Mobile (single ISP)
ChinaTelecom_L2: China Telecom_L2 (single ISP)
ChinaUnicom_L2: China Unicom_L2 (single ISP)
ChinaMobile_L2: China Mobile_L2 (single ISP)

Different acceleration regions support different single-ISP BGP lines
IspTypeList.description_zh:
加速地域公网线路类型。
BGP（默认值）：BGP（多线）线路。
BGP_PRO：BGP（多线）_精品线路。

如果您是单线带宽的白名单用户，您还可能返回以下类型：
ChinaTelecom：中国电信（单线）
ChinaUnicom：中国联通（单线）
ChinaMobile：中国移动（单线）
ChinaTelecom_L2：中国电信（单线）_L2
ChinaUnicom_L2：中国联通（单线）_L2
ChinaMobile_L2：中国移动（单线）_L2

加速地域不同，支持的单线线路类型不同
